property_summary: For any call sequence, after any user claims their reward, the reward they receive must equal their balance multiplied by the reward rate that was active at the moment of their most recent deposit. The buggy contract stores msg.value instead of rewardRate, so after a deposit with a non‑zero msg.value and a subsequent claim, the reward may differ from the reference where the snapshot matches rewardRate.
change_summary: Replace rateSnapshot assignment with one that uses msg.value as the snapshot rate so the stored snapshot differs.
